title: Rig Relay Tool Output Artifact
description: Self-describing artifact envelope for durable tool output analysis.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for the artifact envelope.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for the artifact record.

session_id.description: Session identifier associated with the artifact.

source_event_id.description: Optional source event identifier that produced the artifact.

tool_name.description: Tool name that generated the artifact.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the artifact envelope was written.

payload_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the canonical serialized payload object.

artifact_record_sha256.description: Optional SHA256 hash of the full envelope excluding this field.

byte_size.description: Byte size of the canonical payload bytes.

mime_type.description: MIME type for the embedded payload.

encoding.description: Text encoding used for the serialized artifact.

raw_payload_kind.description: Kind of raw payload embedded in the artifact.

truncated_for_prompt.description: Whether the prompt-visible excerpt was truncated.

prompt_visible_byte_size.description: Byte size of the prompt-visible excerpt.

prompt_excerpt.description: Prompt-visible excerpt derived from the raw payload.

payload.description: Embedded raw payload object that remains portable and analyzable.

metadata.description: Producer metadata describing provenance of the artifact file.
